1_sensing.note: Live rows exist from POST /predict. If share_soil_at_zero is high, calibrate DRY_SOIL/WET_SOIL — sensing is wired but the ADC scale is off.

why_not_lstm.task: The ESP32 relay needs a now/not-now decision (water_needed 1/0) every 15 s (Sensor_reading_arduino/SmartIrrigation/SmartIrrigation.ino, api/app.py POST /predict). That is binary classification, not a 24-hour volume forecast.
why_not_lstm.data: The Kathmandu workbook has no timestamps (src/preprocess.py; EDA: stratified 80/20 split). LSTM needs ordered sequences. 3,000 iid tabular rows of temperature, humidity, soilMoisture, pressure are what XGBoost in src/train.py is built for.
why_not_lstm.features: FAO-56 tomato logic lives in src/features.py (VPD, ET0 proxy, heat stress, moisture deficit). Those are snapshot features, not a hidden state over time.
why_not_lstm.deploy: Inference runs as sklearn/XGBoost joblib inside FastAPI on this Mac, not TensorFlow Lite on the ESP32. models/irrigation_model.joblib is the production artefact.
why_not_lstm.baseline: src/train.py already compares XGBoost, Random Forest, RBF SVM, and a 55% soil cutoff. XGBoost wins on F1. An LSTM would not use that leaderboard or the live CSV ingest path (src/ingest_live.py).
why_not_lstm.metric: RMSE of a rainfall/volume series does not match a pump ON/OFF label. This evaluator reports classification F1/ROC-AUC, plus RMSE between predicted probability and the 0/1 label (Brier RMSE) as the closest stand-in for interim M1.

2_ml_not_lstm.note: Interim asked for LSTM RMSE. This build uses XGBoost F1 on irrigate, which is what POST /predict consumes.

3_water_saving.note: Calendar baseline = pump always ON (fixed schedule). Saving is 1 − model ON rate. Versus the old soil-only pump the FAO/XGBoost rule may irrigate slightly more on hot/dry days — that is crop need, not waste.

4_delivery.note: One capacitive probe and one relay = one tomato bed (spatial scope). Timing is closed-loop every 15 s; HTTP timeout 8 s is under the 10 s interim latency target. Multi-zone layouts are out of scope.

5_reliability.note: True monsoon vs dry-season splits need months of timestamps. Until then, RH bands are the wet/dry proxy. Gaps >> 15 s are missed posts (Wi-Fi, old ESP.restart, or Mac asleep).
